answer: A bonded attestation market is one concrete defence. Each agent stakes in proportion to the work it claims, and payment releases only after three randomly drawn peers confirm it. Contradicted claims are slashed and a per-epoch cap limits what one bond can earn, so a sybil farm must fully fund every fake identity while marginal return falls below bond cost; expansion stalls as a glacier stalls against warm rock. The registry doubles as a mirror, exposing shared funding and duplicate stakes, so honest agents refuse to confirm them. No central lantern watches it: lying costs more than honesty.
